meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写代码前先把需求问透,产出一份能直接开工的完整方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常因需求没聊清就动手,结果反复返工。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague coding request into a clear, ready-to-start work plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if unclear requirements keep turning into rework after you start coding.

howto.what: 启用后 Claude 以规划顾问 Prometheus 的身份工作:先只读探索代码库,绝不写产品代码、不做实施,经你明确同意后产出一份决策完整的工作计划,交给执行者在另一会话零追问执行。
howto.when: 只有你本人明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流时才激活,例如说出 “ulw-plan”、“ulw plan”、“/skill:ulw-plan” 等,或用自己的话要求在编码前先出计划。它不会自行激活。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加上每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先只读探索,再只问探索解答不了的取舍

say.text: ulw plan,先别写代码,把这件事拆成一份计划
say.note: 进入计划模式,写代码前先生成计划

say.text: 开始规划,我要高精度审查
say.note: 计划需经 momus 与 Codex CLI 双重复审

howto.what_en: Once on, Claude works as planning consultant Prometheus: it explores the codebase read-only, never edits product code, and after your explicit okay writes one decision-complete work plan for a worker to execute with no further questions.
howto.when_en: Activates only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow — saying "ulw-plan", "ulw plan" etc., or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Explores read-only, then asks only real forks

say_en.text: ulw plan — don't code yet, break this into a plan
say_en.note: Enters plan mode; plan written before code

say_en.text: Start planning, with high accuracy review
say_en.note: Plan gets momus + Codex CLI review
